comparisons.label: GAAP diluted EPS
comparisons.importance: GAAP EPS increased, but this is not a surprise versus analyst expectations.

comparisons.label: GAAP gross margin
comparisons.importance: Change measured in percentage points, not percent growth.

drivers.label: Data Center expansion
drivers.finding: Data Center revenue was $89.0B, up 117% year over year, making AI infrastructure a major reported growth driver.
drivers.quote: Data Center revenue of $89.0 billion, up 117% from a year ago

drivers.label: Guidance includes China exclusion
drivers.finding: The $108B ±2% next-quarter revenue outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China. Assess exposure before extrapolating.
drivers.quote: NVIDIA is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its outlook.

comparisons.label: Revenue
comparisons.importance: Total sales grew, but source one-offs matter for earnings quality.

comparisons.label: Diluted EPS
comparisons.importance: Reported EPS includes $0.11 favorable tariff refund impact disclosed by Apple.

comparisons.label: Gross profit
comparisons.importance: Gross profit in dollars; not a reported margin rate.

comparisons.label: Operating income
comparisons.importance: Operating earnings growth adjusted for no extra assumptions.

comparisons.label: Services revenue
comparisons.importance: A distinct revenue stream that can grow more slowly than hardware.

comparisons.label: iPhone revenue
comparisons.importance: A concentration and demand sensitivity factor.

drivers.label: Tariff refunds boost headline results
drivers.finding: Apple states its 50.1% reported gross margin benefited by approximately 2 percentage points from tariff refunds and its $2.02 EPS benefited by $0.11. These are reported impacts, not independently calculated normalized results.
drivers.quote: Company gross margin was 50.1 percent, including a favorable impact of approximately 2 percentage points from tariff refunds.

drivers.label: Hardware and Services both contributed
drivers.finding: iPhone and Services revenues grew year-over-year, but at different rates. Compare their relative growth rather than assuming the same driver explains both.

comparisons.label: GAAP diluted EPS
comparisons.importance: GAAP per-share result; distinct from non-GAAP EPS.

comparisons.label: GAAP operating income
comparisons.importance: Core operating comparison, separate from other income.

comparisons.label: More Personal Computing revenue
comparisons.importance: A contracting segment despite company-wide expansion.

drivers.label: EPS includes discrete benefits
drivers.finding: Microsoft disclosed $0.27 per share of benefit relative to April guidance from several discrete items, including a $3.2B Anthropic investment gain. Do not treat all GAAP EPS growth as recurring operating improvement.
drivers.quote: Several discrete items impacted our financial results ... resulting in a benefit of $0.27 on diluted earnings per share.

drivers.label: Cloud growth alongside consumer pressure
drivers.finding: Azure and other cloud services grew 43% year over year while More Personal Computing segment sales declined. A strong consolidated quarter can mask segment divergence.
drivers.quote: Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 43%
